name: native-select
behavior: None beyond the platform's own — a native <select>. The user agent supplies the listbox behaviour (open, typeahead, arrow navigation, Esc), so no APG implementation is authored here; the component must not intercept those keys. Labelling and description come from field composition.

parts.note: positioning wrapper — holds the control and the decorative indicator; it exists because the native control cannot paint its own chevron

parts.statesNote: hover uses field-border-hover/field-surface-hover; invalid swaps field-border for status-critical per states.md — identical recipe to anatomy/input.json's root

parts.note: decorative chevron, aria-hidden and pointer-inert; the native appearance is suppressed so this is the only visible affordance. It does NOT rotate on open — the platform popup is not a state this component can observe
native <option>; the platform paints the popup, so nothing beyond colour-scheme is themeable inside it

anatomyNotes: Salt has no native-select: its Dropdown is a fully authored listbox, so this anatomy is shadcn-only and its Salt translation falls back to anatomy/select.json (contract/variants.md §Fallback ladder). The trigger recipe is deliberately identical to select's root and input's root — a native select must be visually indistinguishable from the authored one. The open state is absent from the state list on purpose: the popup belongs to the user agent and cannot be observed or styled.
